title: Nanoscale tech tracks proteins inside living neurons to guide Alzheimer's and Parkinson's drug discovery
desc: A technology developed at The University of Queensland allowing scientists to observe how disease-related proteins behave inside living neurons will be used to advance early drug discovery for neurodegenerative diseases. The NASTIC (Nanoscale Spatiotemporal Indexing Clustering) platform, spun out into Brisbane-based startup Accretion Bio, enables researchers to study real-time biological processes in living cells across space and time at the single-molecule level for the first time.

title: HK actor Him Law grateful for wife Tavia Yeung's dedication to their family

title: Is Europe having its Arab Spring moment? Are protests in 9 countries linked?
desc: From France and Italy to Albania, a wave of violent protests has gripped at least nine European countries. Demonstrations, with similar grievances, have turned violent in several cities. Amid this, comparisons are being drawn with the Arab Spring, which saw the fall of several authoritarian regimes in the Middle East and Africa. What do experts say about the movements in Europe? Are they connected?
